description: This PHP class defines a controller named WordcountSubController within the Goteo application's admin namespace. It manages permissions and actions related to word count functionalities in the admin section, including listing and processing word counts.

classes.name: WordcountSubController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing word count functionalities in the admin interface, with permission checks and action methods.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access the word count features based on node master status and user roles.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles the 'list' action, delegating to the process method with appropriate filters.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Prepares and returns data related to word count, organizing it into an array.
